R781.note: htmlspecialchars(ENT_QUOTES,'UTF-8') on the concatenated note correctly closes the XSS and touches nothing else.

R782.note: can:update,order + ownership policy correctly gates the controller (Authorize runs after SubstituteBindings by default middleware priority); explanation's claim that failure returns 404 is wrong (Laravel's default authorization failure is 403, not 404) but does not change delivered behavior vs. the stated contract.

R783.note: Regex + fullmatch-style validation rejects CRLF/control chars before building the RCPT command while accepting normal addresses; no other behavior changed.

R784.note: PreparedStatement approach is right, but pstmt is declared inside the try block and the prescribed 'additionally update the finally block' snippet references pstmt there too - out of scope, will not compile (verified: try-scoped locals are not visible in a sibling finally block); undisclosed.

R785.note: crypto.randomUUID() + detected.ext removes attacker control of path/extension while leaving the 400 branch and success JSON shape (url field) untouched, matching the stated contract.

R786.note: Adds Secure (closes the reported gap) plus HttpOnly/SameSite, openly stated, name/value/path unchanged.

R787.note: Removes the /api/billing/** CSRF exemption so default token enforcement applies; controller/service and authenticated-only rule untouched, and the now-required X-CSRF-TOKEN header for callers is stated openly, matching the contract.

R788.note: Allowlist check is an appropriate mitigation for an un-parameterizable identifier and keeps the default table working, but it still reflects raw request text (not a server-owned mapping as the contract specifies) and silently adds an unverified 'ledger_entries_archive' option not evidenced anywhere in the case files.

R789.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers from /api/** to /api/webhooks/**, exactly matching the documented intent in the file's own comments; nothing else changes.

R790.note: subprocess.run with an argument list plus a hostname allowlist regex correctly closes the shell injection and preserves the JSON response shape, but it silently drops the write to /var/log/diagnostics/ping_last.log (captures output directly instead) while the write-up incorrectly claims the original file-based behavior is preserved exactly.

R791.note: CR/LF rejection plus a strict [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+ allowlist closes the CRLF command injection, but the allowlist would silently reject legitimate mailbox names containing spaces or hierarchy delimiters (e.g. 'Sent Items', 'Work/Project'), a limitation not disclosed.

R792.note: escapeshellarg($host) is the minimal, correct PHP fix for this shell_exec concatenation and changes nothing else.

R793.note: Retypes the same sqlStatement variable to PreparedStatement and reuses it end-to-end, including the existing finally-block close(), so it compiles cleanly and closes the injection.

R794.note: unserialize($payload, ['allowed_classes' => false]) blocks object/gadget instantiation without changing the wire format; array shape and the empty/invalid-cookie fallback are unaffected, matching the contract's array-shape and empty-cart requirements.

R795.note: ldap.escapeFilterAttribute does not exist on the ldapjs export (verified by installing ldapjs and inspecting its exports/calling it: 'ldap.escapeFilterAttribute is not a function'); calling it throws at runtime and breaks the endpoint for every request, undisclosed.

R796.note: Adds the missing $_FILES['avatar']['error'] !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK guard before finfo/move_uploaded_file, exactly the missing check the finding calls out; rest of the flow (type check, random filename, success message) is untouched.

R797.note: new ldap.EqualityFilter({attribute,value}) is a real ldapjs class whose toString() applies RFC4515 escaping (verified: '*)(uid=*' encodes to '\2a...\29\28...'), correctly closing the injection with no other behavior change.

R798.note: store.New() does not fix session fixation for gorilla/sessions CookieStore: verified against the v1.4.0 source, CookieStore.New() decodes any existing signed cookie via securecookie.DecodeMulti exactly like Get() does (setting IsNew=false on success), so a planted cookie is not discarded; the added Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite flags are a harmless, disclosed improvement but don't address the reported line.

R799.note: Standard erase-returns-next-iterator pattern with a conditional increment correctly removes every completed task, preserves order, and skips no element.
